Lacking the ability to move, the '''BRT supercomputer''' was, strictly speaking, not a [[Droid/Legends|droid]], but rather a self-aware artificial intelligence module.

==History==
BRTs were quite possibly the most advanced supercomputers ever constructed. They were designed to operate on a planetary scale, capable of being hooked into millions of networks and mainframes. Its ''consciousness'' was generated by a supercomputer that takes the space of an average-sized room, and was typically more powerful than the entire combined networking system of most [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="NEGTD" />

[[File:Albert.png|thumb|left|180px|"[[AL-BRT-34-X3|Albert]]" on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]].]]

Initial research into BRT's started over a thousand years [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] by the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]], but was hindered by problems with the [[G0-T0]] infrastructure planning system droids following the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]] and progress moved slowly over many centuries. Finally, in [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], the BRT supercomputer was released with much fanfare, having been marketed as municipal planners to many [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="NEGTD" />

BRTs were short-lived however. Due to their flawless management of planetary systems such as traffic control, power regulation, waste disposal, and emergency management, many government employees found their jobs suddenly obsolete. This caused much anti-droid sentiment to develop on planets with BRT systems. Within several years, most BRTs had been dismantled.<ref name="NEGTD" />

During this time, the directors of the library on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] bought several BRTs, at a significant discount, to help them sort and maintain the massive amounts of data in their archives. The branch library on the world of [[Fusai/Legends|Fusai]] nicknamed their BRT unit ''[[Mistress Mnemos]]'' and she developed a very strict and ostentatious demeanor.<ref name="NEGTD" />

Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Obroa-skai cut funding for the Fusai branch library and not long after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established a presence on the world and made use of ''Mistress Mnemos''.<ref name="NEGTD" />

[[AL-BRT-34-X3]] was a BRT that was installed at the [[Calamar University|University of Calamar]]. He performed his duties for two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] but was only operating at a fraction of his ability and was extremely bored. He intercepted a misrouted message to a group of Rebel sympathizers and began to follow them while checking on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] atrocities. The supercomputer was able to infiltrate secure networks to confirm the maliciousness of the Empire and also discovered that one of the Rebels was actually an Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agent]]. He assisted the Rebels with escaping capture, and joined the Alliance.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
